chunks: And it has been narrated that:
"One should perform ghusl (ritual bath) on the night of the seventeenth."
ai.seo_question: What is narrated about performing ghusl on the night of the seventeenth?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a recommended ritual act: performing ghusl (ritual bath) on the night of the seventeenth. It reflects a devotional and jurisprudential practice connected to sacred times.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2016 - It has also been narrated that:
"One should perform the ritual bath (ghusl) on the night of the seventeenth."
